Maps are now ordered sequentially.

notes.title: 0.1.5 Update
notes.content:
With our new version, we have made some important fixes to improve your gaming experience. Here are the updates in this version:


 Fixed the symbol reset issue.
 Improved the matchmaking system to ensure players do not match with the same opponents consecutively.
 Increased the maximum number of games to 12.
 Fixed the win rate calculation.
 Resolved the jumping issue.
 Fixed the issue in tutorial mode.
 Updated the shooting mechanism.
 Fixed the mouse sensitivity adjustment..


We hope these updates make your gaming experience more enjoyable and smooth. Happy gaming!

notes.title: 0.1.3 Update
notes.content:
We’ve made some important fixes and improvements in our latest update. Here’s what you can expect from this update:


 Win Rate Adjustment: Win rates are now more accurately reflected.
 Mouse Sensitivity Fixed: Issues with mouse sensitivity have been resolved. 
 Matchmaking Issues Fixed: Fixed issues with the matchmaking process for faster and fairer matches.
 Lobby Sound Fixed: Sound issues in the lobby have been addressed.
 Various Bug Fixes: Small bugs and issues have been fixed, with general performance improvements made.
 Streamer Mode Added: A new Streamer Mode has been added!


We look forward to your feedback and comments! Thank you for your continued support.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Our New Parkour Game is Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Gamers,

We are thrilled to announce that our highly anticipated new parkour game, designed to be played with friends, is now live! After months of meticulous work and creative processes, we are excited to finally share it with you.

This new adventure invites you into a colorful and fun parkour world. With its unique art style, thrilling races, and innovative game mechanics, it is sure to capture the hearts of gamers everywhere. Compete with your friends in the 6-player multiplayer mode and enjoy the excitement together.

Key Features:

 Colorful Graphics: A parkour world filled with fun and stylized visuals.


 Thrilling Races: Engage in exciting parkour races that will keep you on the edge of your seat.


 6-Player Multiplayer Mode: Compete in various parkour races and modes with your friends.

The game is now available on all platforms. Download and start playing to embark on new parkour adventures and create memorable moments!

Join us and be a part of this unforgettable parkour experience. We eagerly await your feedback and reviews.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Anticipated Game is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

After months of eager anticipation, we finally have exciting news for you! 🎉

Survivor World is launching on July 1st! 🌟

Are you ready to embark on a brand-new parkour adventure with your friends? With stunning graphics, immersive courses, and breathtaking gameplay mechanics, this game is set to revolutionize the gaming world!

Team up with your friends or compete against them in this thrilling world of survival challenges. Survivor World offers competitive fun and unforgettable moments!

The countdown has begun, see you on July 1st! 🚀

Best regards,
Flugames team
